title: How Jason Cohen scaled WP Engine past product-market fit: focus, org design, and hiring execs
summary: Jason Cohen explains how the playbook changes after product-market fit: stop experimenting broadly, concentrate scaled headcount on a few strategic initiatives, set a quarterly one-page plan, and shape the org chart around that focus. He also covers hiring managers and executives better than you, and why he became CTO and hired a CEO.

principles.text: After product-market fit, 'keep experimenting' stops working; scaling a working business needs different behaviors and a different identity.
principles.quote: just saying things like, "We'll keep experimenting." is not how you scale something that's already working.

principles.text: Don't dilute scale across many initiatives; put many people on a few things so you can dominate them.
principles.quote: you want to not dilute your scale across a bunch of projects, but still have just a few things. That way you're using your leverage to win.

principles.text: Each quarter, define the ideal strategy, name what blocks it, then attack or work around the obstacles; keep it to one page.
principles.quote: if you do this every quarter, and it takes no longer than a page to say it, everyone knows at a high level exactly what to do.

principles.text: Reflect the few focus areas in the org chart, either matrixed or by dedicated initiative teams; neither is free.
principles.quote: the bottom line is the org chart somehow needs to reflect this focus so that you don't get bogged down again in crap.

principles.text: Great managers are team builders, not the best individual contributors; interview for that skill.
principles.quote: Their job is to build the team and to work on conflicts and to figure out these priorities and to work with other teams and so on.

principles.text: Hire executives better than you by asking references to describe the scenarios where the person thrives and where they'd be destroyed, then check fit with your company.
principles.quote: What is the perfect scenario where this person is an absolute superstar?
